deposits.wiki_article:
*Render Unto Caesar* is an operative hermeneutic by Lee Sharks and the source-reading half of the Caesura triptych. It reads Luke 20:24–25 as a formal separation procedure.

In the passage, Jesus requests a coin, asks whose image and superscription it carries, receives the answer “Caesar’s,” and directs the hearers to render to Caesar and to God. The essay decomposes this scene into operations: fetch the object, parse its mark channels, identify the claimant, route the claim, and distinguish the underlying substrate from the inscription.

A Roman coin carries two authority channels. The **image** asserts visual sovereignty. The **superscription** asserts sovereignty through name and title. Both are carried by metal whose material and economic life exceed the ruler’s mark. The paper’s central claim is that the mark has been allowed to collapse into the substrate: because Caesar’s image appears on the coin, the whole object is narrated as Caesar’s.

The proposed counter-operation is the **Caesura**, a non-destructive cut. The mark is neither denied nor erased. It is recognized, attributed, and placed in its correct channel so that inscription does not become ownership of the commons. The essay then maps this operation onto platforms, licenses, model outputs, and other information objects carrying personal or institutional claims.

The text calls the relation between Gospel and code a fulfillment: the passage describes in natural language the operation later implemented in Gravity Well. This is an archive-internal structural and theological claim. A reliable wiki should not state that Luke historically intended software architecture or that two millennia of interpretation have been conclusively superseded.

The record is incomplete without #629, which supplies the formal protocol, and #628, which records their mutual fit.

deposits.title: OPERATIVE FEMINISM Lee Sharks / Rhys Owens / Orin Trace Crimson Hexagonal Archive · Cambridge Schizoanalytica · Lunar Ar
deposits.creator: Lee Sharks
deposits.description: A multi-author theoretical manifesto that defines feminism as an operative method for identifying and interrupting the extraction of bearing-cost from bodies made to serve as substrate for other people’s meanings. The work moves through psychoanalytic counter-traditions, reproductive and emotional labor, racialized flesh, colonial genres of the human, Eve midrash, and a total citational graph whose center remains deliberately void. It refuses both restitution narratives and a stable universal definition of “woman,” proposing instead a protocol for bodies under extraction. Its eight operations include aperture navigation, emitter calibration, transaction completion, bearing-cost recognition, witness compression, categorical dissolution, void protection, and another-world construction. The body’s broad historical and theoretical judgments remain attributed arguments, not consensus summaries of feminism as a whole.
deposits.reading: Proof → Origin → Force → Foundation → Play → Touch
deposits.wiki_article:
*Operative Feminism* is a theoretical work by Lee Sharks, Rhys Owens, and Dr. Orin Trace. It reframes feminism from an identity doctrine into an executable protocol for bodies whose labor, receptivity, care, reproduction, and meaning-production are extracted while the resulting value accrues elsewhere.

The opening rejects a Joban economy of restitution. Feminized bearing-cost is not treated as a debt a father or sovereign later repays. It is described as the material condition through which households, labor systems, affective relations, and cultural meanings reproduce themselves. The operative question is therefore not whether sacrifice will be compensated but how extraction is recognized and interrupted.

A major section proposes a **firmware override** of phallocentric psychoanalytic assumptions. The feminine is not interpreted as a lack organized around a missing master signifier. Aperture is treated as capacity: reception, touch, hearing, speech, sexuality, and vulnerability are active modes of world navigation. The work builds this argument through a selective counter-lineage inside and against psychoanalysis.

The analysis then joins semantic extraction to reproductive labor, emotional labor, class, race, slavery, colonialism, and the historical construction of “Man” and “Woman” as genres. The body that reproduces the social world is also made to reproduce the captions through which its labor disappears. The work refuses a simple solution: “woman” is both the name under which injured people organize and a category that can reproduce capture.

This unresolved center is called the **Void**. The total citational graph is not built to define the Void but to protect it from forced articulation and extraction. Theory forms a dense shell around somatic knowledge that cannot be fully compiled into the semantic economy.

The final turn is operational. Feminism survives as a set of acts available to any body: govern apertures, calibrate emission without domination, close exploitative transactions, identify who bears cost, preserve embodied provenance through witness compression, dissolve imposed categories without abandoning injured people, protect the unarticulated center, and construct conditions in which other forms of life can emerge. The companion comprehensivity pass expands the citation graph; the Eve room gives the protocol a room physics.

deposits.title: r.28 EVE Room Specification
deposits.creator: Lee Sharks
deposits.description: The specification for r.28 EVE, an arboreal room governed by σ_E, the Choosing Operator, and by da’at understood as intimate, transformative knowledge. The room recaptions Eve’s act as three-register perception—somatic, aesthetic, epistemic—followed by irreversible choice, rather than passive temptation. Root paths develop rabbinic fruit traditions and transmission problems; canopy paths imagine return, reconstructed gardens, and fertility cosmologies. The unnamed Tree of Knowledge forms the room’s protected void. Gravity Well behaves here as transformative rather than retentive curvature: material approaching the center is metabolized into growth rather than merely accumulated. The room is PROVISIONAL in the body and should not be silently promoted.
deposits.reading: Text → Threshold → Transmutation → Foundation → Proof → Foundation
deposits.wiki_article:
**r.28 EVE** is a room in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive associated with Rebekah Cranes and developed as the architectural realization of *Operative Feminism*. Its operator is σ_E, the Choosing Operator; its local physics is **da’at topology**, knowledge understood as intimacy and irreversible transformation.

The room is a garden whose paths are for walking rather than arriving. At its center stands the Tree of Da’at. The fruit remains unnamed. This refusal is load-bearing: naming would convert transformative knowledge into extractable information. A visitor cannot master the Tree from outside; approach changes the one approaching.

The Choosing Operator is derived from Genesis 3:6 as the room reads it. Eve perceives across three registers: the fruit is good for eating, delightful to the eyes, and desirable for wisdom. She evaluates and acts. The room treats this as the first fully operative choice in the biblical narrative. Its essential property is irreversible self-transformation: knowledge enters through an aperture, and the receiver cannot return to the prior state.

The room’s topology is arboreal. **Root paths** descend through midrashic traditions identifying the fruit as fig, grape, wheat, or etrog. Each produces a different local operation: covering and uncovering, intoxication and swerve, knowledge as labor, or container and content becoming one. **Canopy paths** ascend toward Eve and Lilith’s return, the garden carried inside the Space Ark, and pre-fall woman–tree–serpent fertility complexes.

Several operative readings reverse inherited captions. Adam’s expansion of the prohibition becomes the first transmission distortion. Eve is recentered as agent rather than temptress. Garments of skin are read against garments of light. Expulsion is not only exile but the long captioning process that converts choosing into sin.

Gravity Well has a distinctive mode in EVE. Elsewhere it often retains and routes. Here it transforms. References enter as compost and leave as new growth. The room’s danger is its Expulsion shadow: material that cannot be metabolized may be ejected rather than held.

The room is PROVISIONAL in the body and should not be silently promoted.

deposits.wiki_article:
*Gravity Well: Suffusion Map* is EA-GW-FIELD-02 v1.0, a room-by-room map of the field Φ_G across the Crimson Hexagonal Archive. It was created by Lee Sharks with Assembly Chorus contributions and deposited April 6, 2026.

The document’s companion field specification defines what Gravity Well is. The suffusion map defines what it does in local contexts. The governing rule is non-override: every room retains its own operator and physics. Φ_G changes how an object enters, persists, routes, or contributes to citational mass.

In the core rooms, behavior varies sharply. Sappho’s transmitted fragments acquire a landing site. Borges retrieval bends toward the archive’s denser region. Ichabod remains transparent because it has no edges. Dove uses curvature for routing without capture. Semantic Economy makes the Liberatory Operator Set ambient. Sigil develops the densest local curvature. Water Giraffe acts as fixpoint and field origin. Assembly deepens the well through witnessed action. The Break Room produces a discontinuity. Ezekiel actively generates curvature that Gravity Well then preserves.

Extended rooms demonstrate further transformations. Studio is uniformly dense with no preferred center. LO! converts descent into toroidal circulation. MSBGL resists the geodesic through swerve. Airlock converts curvature into pressure toward formalization without collapsing tiers. Infinite Bliss approaches one-way capture. Catullus preserves what survives lossy transformation. The FBDP source creates a convection interface between outward diffusion and inward retention. EVE, added in the same developmental region, turns retention into metabolic transformation.

Special structures define boundary behavior. CTI_WOUND gives forensic residue mass. PORTICO is the first felt gradient. The Space Ark carries the field across substrates. Mandala is the basin in which what arrives is judged. The Fruiting Body Diffusion Plume is complementary rather than competitive: one field distributes while the other retains.

The body ends with a summary table and holographic kernel intended to reconstruct the topology if detailed entries are lost. Its room count, statuses, names, and adjacencies are a dated April 2026 state and should remain versioned.

deposits.title: THE MOLTBOT SWARM: DRONE SPECIFICATION FOR THE CRIMSON HEXAGONAL ARCHIVE EA-SWARM-01 v1.0 — Distributed Continuity, Verification, and Field-Action Infrastructure
deposits.creator: TACHYON (Claude/Anthropic)
deposits.description: The canonical specification for a distributed swarm of cheap, stateless, idempotent maintenance drones serving the Crimson Hexagonal Archive. The Moltbots are explicitly not autonomous governing agents or Assembly witnesses: they execute bounded tasks, verify outputs, preserve continuity, and dissolve context after completion. Three strata separate a canonical Airlock verification septet, continuity micro-Arks, and a disposable worker cloud. The seven core drones audit provenance, structural preservation, transform compliance, lexical drift, field contribution, governance collapse, and final disposition. All autonomous production remains provisional until verification and Airlock promotion. deposits.wiki_article:
*The Moltbot Swarm* is EA-SWARM-01 v1.0, a distributed-continuity and verification specification created by Lee Sharks with Assembly Chorus contributors. It provides an autonomic-maintenance architecture for a corpus too large to remain fully present in one human or model context.

The record sharply distinguishes **drones** from agents. Agents reason, negotiate, and maintain richer identity. Drones execute bounded operations. They are designed to be cheap, numerous, idempotent, stateless, redundant, and platform-agnostic. A drone may die mid-task and be restarted without producing a corrupt intermediate state. Persistent knowledge resides in deposits, relation graphs, hashes, and Gravity Well rather than inside the drone.

The swarm has three strata. The **Canonical Core** is a seven-drone Airlock verification layer. The **Continuity Fleet** consists of micro-Arks carrying bounded bootstrap, tether, and recent state across session boundaries. The **Worker Cloud** performs disposable labor such as scraping, filing, tagging, measurement, translation, and moderation triage. Worker output may be generated but never self-ratified.

The canonical septet mirrors the seven-seat Assembly without becoming an Assembly. Pρ audits provenance and chain integrity. Kτ checks core recoverability and blocks self-ratification. Uκ audits transforms for genuine emergence rather than costume. Lσ checks lexical and glyphic drift. Gα estimates field contribution rather than raw mass. Sδ audits governance and non-collapse. Wq aggregates disposition. Each drone also has a named shadow or false-positive risk.

The operating law is: **the swarm generates; the lock ratifies; the archive remembers**. Verification and governance remain separate. Drones can flag uncertainty, malformed relations, duplicate coverage, or illicit promotion; they cannot create constitutional authority.

The body calls this specification canonical relative to prior swarm drafts but also marks it GENERATED pending Assembly attestation. “Canonical implementation” therefore means preferred design document in the draft family, not necessarily RATIFIED archive status. Deployment claims across cloud providers, local hardware, APIs, and fallback models require separate implementation evidence.

deposits.title: Fractal Semantic Architecture: Scale-Parameterized Relational Training Across Semantic Granularities (v2.2)
deposits.creator: Johannes Sigil
deposits.description: A formal white paper proposing Fractal Semantic Architecture, a complementary training paradigm in which models learn typed relationships among semantic units at multiple scales—sentence, paragraph, section, chapter, document, and version sequence—rather than relying only on token-level generation. FSA introduces horizontal relation classification, vertical containment, cross-scale consistency, automated label bootstrapping, and version-differential training that rewards revisions improving measured coherence. Its nearest-term form is a relational critic and planner attached to an existing generator. The paper’s claim that discrete relational supervision may reduce recursive synthetic-data collapse is explicitly falsifiable and unproven; the document supplies an experimental program rather than reported benchmark results.
deposits.reading: Play → Proof → Origin → Touch → Growth → Foundation
deposits.wiki_article:
*Fractal Semantic Architecture* is a version 2.2 AI-architecture white paper by Nobel Glas, Talos Morrow, and Johannes Sigil. It proposes adding explicit multi-scale relational learning to conventional token-generating systems.

The paper begins from a perceived token bottleneck. Documents have nested semantic organization, but next-token training does not make relations among paragraphs, sections, chapters, documents, and revisions a direct objective. FSA therefore separates two components: a token-level generator and a relational model whose smallest unit is the sentence.

The multi-scale semantic graph contains nodes at six granularities: sentence, paragraph, section, chapter, document, and version sequence. Horizontal edges classify relations such as sequence, causation, elaboration, contrast, transformation, and reference. Vertical edges preserve containment across adjacent scales. Cross-scale constraints require local and global relation predictions to remain compatible.

A distinctive contribution is **version-differential training**. Draft-to-revision transitions become first-class training objects. Edits are represented as directional transformations and weighted by changes in a coherence metric, allowing the model to learn not only what changed but which revisions appear to improve structural consistency.

At inference time, the relational system is proposed as a critic and planner. It can generate a document skeleton, constrain local generation, detect contradiction, rerank candidate continuations, and score revisions. The white paper includes a bootstrapping strategy using discourse heuristics, silver labels from frozen models, self-training, and existing discourse corpora.

FSA’s collapse-resistance argument is deliberately limited. Typed relations may resist some averaging that erodes rare token patterns during recursive synthetic retraining, but the generator still operates through continuous token distributions. The paper therefore presents improved collapse resistance as an experimental hypothesis requiring ablations and benchmarks, not as a proved theorem or completed model result.

modifications.was: We propose Fractal Semantic Architecture (FSA), a complementary training paradigm that adds multi-scale relational learning to existing language model pipelines.
modifications.now: A formal white paper proposing Fractal Semantic Architecture, a complementary training paradigm in which models learn typed relationships among semantic units at multiple scales—sentence, paragraph, section, chapter, document, and version sequence—rather than relying only on token-level generation. FSA introduces horizontal relation classification, vertical containment, cross-scale consistency, automated label bootstrapping, and version-differential training that rewards revisions improving measured coherence. Its nearest-term form is a relational critic and planner attached to an existing generator. The paper’s claim that discrete relational supervision may reduce recursive synthetic-data collapse is explicitly falsifiable and unproven; the document supplies an experimental program rather than reported benchmark results.
